evidence.reproductionScope: Two independent fresh source-tree builds produced identical artifact bytes and receipts under the pinned image. Both passed nineteen patch-contract tests, text/directory/image preflight sanitizers, RecodeNode controls, actual WASM API/trap tests and English/French browser smoke. Five scan/export tests passed against this candidate and separately against the unchanged application core. No cross-host or production certification.

previousRevision.scope: Previously reproduced raw-output-restricted research candidate, superseded by the owned-text bridge/auxiliary API reduction. Never adopted. Its second build reported clock skew; current builds did not.

nativeTextOwnershipVerification.scope: Actual bridge header; original new[]/free mismatch control and corrected malloc-copy/delete[] ownership. Bounds copying, not prior native recognition/serialization allocation or all engine internals.

nativeP6PreflightVerification.scope: Actual native preflight header under sanitizers, plus format/size/orientation refusals through the real WASM SetImageFile entry point. Not whole Leptonica/model fuzz or arbitrary pointer clearance.

nativeModelPreflightVerification.scope: Actual no-allocation directory preflight under sanitizers plus real patched TessdataManager::LoadMemBuffer via a research WASM export. Includes malformed/valid controls, both byte orders and exact eng/fra directories. Not LSTM/DAWG/unicharset decoding, arbitrary pointer or whole-native fuzz clearance.

scanExportVerification.scope: Five Chromium browser tests against this baseline candidate via test-only request interception; no application assets replaced. Synthetic RGB paper/coloured graphics only. Not SIMD, accuracy benchmarking, browser diversity or installed WebView2 clearance.

knownLimits: Old Tesseract 5.3.0 fork remains; no complete native vulnerability clearance.

Leptonica getters now use public functions; 25 raw/ownership bindings trap instead of exposing layouts or C++-deleting C-managed/possibly borrowed objects. The wider generated API is not fully cleared.
Four unavailable legacy/OSD bindings deliberately abort; the candidate supports only the bounded LSTM recognition path.

The RecodeNode nontrivial memcpy was replaced by a hash-bound upstream member-wise assignment with a self-assignment guard. Targeted ownership sanitizer tests pass; other old-engine code and legacy move-like copy semantics are not cleared.

The worker's SetImageFile path admits only canonical bounded P6. Six alternate image, nine optional renderer, three unused model/config, eleven raw component/image/iterator and ten auxiliary output exports abort before argument access. Worker-used Init3/4 and AnalyseLayout overloads remain. Owned JSON/UTF8 text is copied into a bounded malloc buffer compatible with unchanged JS free; the original is released with delete[]. Preceding engine allocation, retained pointer APIs and deeper decoding are not cleared.
Baseline used for all feature-choice URLs in the isolated smoke, not SIMD/relaxed-SIMD validation.
No candidate bytes replaced application assets or were added to Git.

apiSecurityReview.scope: Research artifact only; application runtime is unchanged. Public getter and owned-object self-tests do not establish arbitrary pointer safety or general binding compatibility.
apiSecurityReview.leptonica: Removed pix_internal.h coupling. Seventeen scalar getters use public APIs and reject null pointers; 25 raw-array, reference-count/internal-capacity and ownership-ambiguous destroy accessors abort. The current worker uses TessBaseAPI JSON text results, not those Leptonica wrappers. The synthetic self-test owns all six object types locally and releases them through their matching public destroy functions for 100 cycles.
apiSecurityReview.patchContractTests: Nineteen Python unittest cases execute before the isolated build. Exact inventories/bodies cover public Leptonica getters, six alternate-image, nine renderer, three model/config, eleven raw and ten auxiliary output bindings plus the owned JSON/UTF8 bridge. Image/Init3/Init4, AnalyseLayout and Version remain guarded. Missing/duplicate/new overloads, changed calls and reapplication fail closed. Actual WASM traps, model directory and English/French worker smoke are separate checks.

auxiliaryOutputs.finding: Unused borrowed strings, owned arrays, DAWG pointers and variable output pointers have ownership/provenance obligations outside the editor protocol. Ten exact bindings abort before accessing self/arguments; unchanged worker-used Version is retained. This is surface reduction, not a claim of exploitable vulnerabilities in those getters.
auxiliaryOutputs.verification: Nineteen patch-contract tests include exact inventory/body drift refusals. Each of the ten real WASM exports traps in a fresh instance with an owned API and in-bounds argument storage. Pinned worker entry/dump are checked not to call these methods.
auxiliaryOutputs.remaining: Other configuration, layout iterator, native result construction and deeper parser internals remain unapproved. Application core is unchanged.

ownedTextResults.finding: Pinned native GetUTF8Text/GetJSONText return new[] buffers documented for delete[], but generated JS frees them with _free. Source-level allocation-contract mismatch; not a CVE or WASM exploitability claim.
ownedTextResults.change: Research wrapper takes the owned buffer, copies a complete NUL-terminated result of at most 8 MiB into malloc storage and releases the original with delete[]. Over-budget output refuses without truncation. Generated JS stays unchanged and frees the compatible copy. Null self and JSON page outside 0..499 are refused before native entry.
ownedTextResults.verification: Actual bridge header passes ASan/UBSan, warnings-as-errors, 1000 cycles, 2048 deterministic lengths, UTF8, empty and exact/over-cap cases. Original free(new[]) control exits 42 with allocator mismatch. Research WASM self-test passes 100 cycles; English/French worker recognition passes.
ownedTextResults.limits: The cap bounds bridge copying only, not engine recognition or prior JSON/string construction, arbitrary pointers, other output formats or total native resource use. Research only; not adopted.

rawComponentOutputs.finding: Unused TessBaseAPI bindings return raw Pix/Boxa/ResultIterator pointers and accept Pixa/LongStar output pointers with ownership/allocation obligations outside the editor protocol. The research patch keeps their ABI names but unconditionally aborts before self/argument access, allocation or returning a native object. This reduces exposed API, not an assertion of a proven exploit in the original getters.
rawComponentOutputs.retainedWorkerPath: The pinned worker dump uses GetUTF8Text and GetJSONText for text/blocks, now using the owned-text bridge recorded separately. AnalyseLayout's two overloads remain exact-body guarded. Internal C++ image/component/iterator operations are not patched by replacing exported wrapper bodies. A regression checks the pinned JS worker does not call refused methods.
rawComponentOutputs.verification: All eleven real WASM exports trap in fresh instances with an owned TessBaseAPI and allocated in-bounds argument storage. Exact signatures, bodies, inventory, retained calls and drift refusals are contract-tested. English/French recognition, model/input refusals and scan/export comparisons are exercised separately.
rawComponentOutputs.remaining: Retained layout iterators, configuration/variable setters, native JSON/result construction and other APIs still need review. Owned-text copying is reviewed separately, not whole-native allocation clearance. Not adopted in the shipped core.

modelDirectoryAndApis.finding: Old loader trusts offsets when sizing component vectors and indexes zero-length vectors. The exact-source research patch adds a strict directory preflight before TFile/vector allocation and refuses empty/oversized files before indexing/narrowing. Original Apache copyright/header and explicit modification comments are retained. This is a source finding, not a CVE/exploitability assertion.
modelDirectoryAndApis.retainedInitialization: Both Init3/4 are required: generated JS dispatches empty configuration to Init3, even when the worker syntactically supplies four arguments. A real integration test caught an initial mistaken refusal; the final candidate retains both and regression-tests recognition with the unchanged editor protocol.
modelDirectoryAndApis.validation: No-allocation byte reads support little/big endian, 1..24 slots, complete directory, -1 sentinel only, a contiguous first component and strictly increasing nonempty offsets inside at most 16 MiB. Sanitizer mutation checks and real LoadMemBuffer controls are recorded above. These checks bound directory allocation, not component internals or the preceding file-reader allocation.
modelDirectoryAndApis.remaining: Review deeper traineddata/LSTM/DAWG/unicharset deserialization, other pointer APIs and exact-native advisories. Current application core remains unchanged and the editor still accepts only hash-verified eng/fra bytes.

optionalPdfRenderer.finding: The generated API exposed an unused native PDF renderer with file/model-path arguments, borrowed strings and ownership-sensitive deletion. PDFrig requests text/blocks only and composes invisible text using its PDF engine, not this renderer. All nine exact renderer bindings now abort before allocation, argument/self access or deletion. ABI names remain for unchanged generated JS.
optionalPdfRenderer.verification: Patch drift tests cover signatures, bodies, inventory and repeated application. Each actual WASM export traps in a fresh instance with allocated in-bounds storage; ordinary worker recognition and independent scan/export comparisons still pass.
optionalPdfRenderer.scope: Research-only API reduction, not arbitrary pointer or all-engine security clearance. Native renderer APIs remain present in the unchanged application core.

alternateImageIngestion.finding: Generated bindings exposed six alternate ways to supply arbitrary Pix/raw-buffer pointers or file/page processing, outside the canonical SetImageFile preflight. The local worker does not call them. Their ABI symbols remain for unchanged generated JS but bodies explicitly abort before dereferencing self or any arguments. Internal C++ engine image methods are not rewritten.
alternateImageIngestion.verification: Each real WASM export traps in a fresh module using an owned TessBaseAPI plus allocated in-bounds storage, rather than null-pointer failures as proof. Normal guarded input, English/French recognition and previous controls still pass.
alternateImageIngestion.scope: Deliberately narrow research API, not a general-purpose Tesseract replacement, arbitrary pointer safety proof or complete model/renderer security clearance. Application assets remain unchanged.

apiSecurityReview.nativeImageEntry: Hash-bound baseapi.cpp modification restricts SetImageFile to the exact local-ocr-pixels.ts canonical header, depth 255, positive dimensions of at most eight digits, exact RGB body size and at most 20 million pixels. No input-sized allocation is made by the preflight. Non-default EXIF orientation and rotation are refused. It decodes the same open stream directly with pixReadStreamPnm, avoiding general image format dispatch for this worker path. Standalone ASan/UBSan mutation tests and 1072 actual WASM refusals pass; a later valid input and both language worker smokes pass. Not full PNM/model/native security clearance.

compilerWarning.finding: The original fork lost its owned dawgs pointer on self-assignment and memcpy-copied a non-trivially-copyable object. The candidate now backports the exact upstream assignment method with explicit fields and a self-assignment guard, preserving original copyright plus an explicit modification notice. No casts suppress the warning. No CVE or exploitability is asserted.

verification.scope: Actual extracted RecodeNode struct with instrumented external ownership stubs. Checks self-assignment, replacement of an owned destination, constructor/assignment transfer, all fields, null transfer and destruction. Not whole-engine fuzz/sanitizer clearance.

compilerWarning.nextAction: Review remaining old-fork deltas, legacy move-like copy assumptions and parser/model surface. Broader engine tests and exact final artifact clearance remain required.
